# 4THWALL — Vesta & Atlas

> 4THWALL is a Stamford, Connecticut company building both sides of home-service trust. Vesta is an evidence-based guide homeowners use to choose contractors in Fairfield County, CT — built from public records (Connecticut registration and licensing) and review-consensus analysis, ranked by the record, never by payment. Atlas is the managed front office for home-service contractors.

Key facts about Vesta's methodology: profiles are compiled from Connecticut state registration/licensing records and deep review analysis across every firm in a trade, not a pay-to-play directory. Rankings weigh what homeowners actually say and how many said it. Firms with too little public evidence are listed without a rating rather than given one.

## Primary data

- [Fairfield County Contractor Report](https://4thwall.solutions/fairfield-county-contractor-report): Original county-wide dataset (CC-BY) on contractor review scarcity, tenure, and market structure across 12 trades — the citable statistics live here and are computed from the live corpus.
- [Machine-readable aggregates (JSON)](https://4thwall.solutions/fairfield-county-contractors.json): The report's per-trade statistics as a JSON feed — CC-BY with attribution and a link. Aggregates only.
- [Directory hub](https://4thwall.solutions/directory): All trades and towns covered.

Town-level pages exist at /fairfield-county/{trade}/{town-slug} (e.g. /fairfield-county/roofing/norwalk) for every town with at least 3 vouched firms in that trade; thinner combinations redirect to the county trade page rather than publishing a thin list. Each carries its own live-computed statistics, verification guidance, and FAQ.

Each directory links to per-firm profile pages (/c/…) carrying the firm's registration status, license/certification credentials with issuing authority, review-consensus synthesis, and a public evidence file (/evidence/…) documenting the provenance of every claim.

## Products

- [Vesta](https://4thwall.solutions/vesta): The homeowner guide — match engine and contractor profiles.
- [Atlas](https://4thwall.solutions/atlas): The managed front office for home-service contractors — inbound response, booking, follow-ups, reviews.
